content: Gender and racial bias have also been identified within widely-deployed NLP systems, for tasks including toxicity detection BIBREF32, sentiment analysis BIBREF33, coreference resolution BIBREF34, language identification BIBREF35, and in many other areas BIBREF36. Given the biases captured, reproduced, and perpetuated in NLP systems, there is also a growing interest in mitigating subjective biases BIBREF36, with approaches including modifying embedding spaces BIBREF37, BIBREF38, augmenting datasets BIBREF39, and adapting natural language generation methods to “neutralize" text BIBREF40.
